entities.summary: Dominic Aduna Bingab Nitiwul is a Ghanaian politician and a Member of Parliament (MP) for the Bimbilla constituency in the Northern Region of Ghana. He has also served in the Pan-African Parliament. Nitiwul has held the office of Minister of Defence of Ghana from February 2017 to January 2025.
